title: He is all in all
html_source:
A quotation from Hamlet Act I, Scene 2, where Hamlet the protagonist describes his deceased father, also named Hamlet:

“He was a man, take him for all in all,
I shall not look upon his like again.”

 Judge Eglinton summed up. 

 — The truth is midway, he affirmed. He is the ghost and the prince.

 — He is, Stephen said. The boy of act one is the mature man of act five. All in all. In Cymbeline, in Othello he is bawd and cuckold. He acts and is acted on. Lover of an idea
